AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:description: Aither is the family's AI app. Its functions only read or open pages of the app; none acts on its own. Operational patterns: - askAither opens the on-device assistant with a question; it answers on the phone. - askHearth only writes the request into Hearth's box; the owner sends it, and anything that leaves the home waits for an approval card. - pendingApprovals is read-only and reflects the last check of the household inbox. Constraints: - On a child's phone only openApp and pendingApprovals are available.
